title: Kubernetes Container Orchestration Architecture
description: A Kubernetes container orchestration architecture diagram showing the control plane (API Server, etcd, Scheduler, Controller Manager), worker nodes (Kubelet, container runtime, kube-proxy, pods), networking layer (Ingress, Network Policy, Service Mesh), and persistent storage with CSI drivers. This template provides a comprehensive view of the Kubernetes architecture stack from control plane to storage layer. Foundational reference for DevOps engineers and platform teams managing Kubernetes clusters.
